decisions: Review: outbox tick lock approved as written
Review: scheduler window path approved; grid-slot loop gets the same same-instant guard as the flex loop (gap 0 case)
Review: editor write approved (conflict target matches the 0009 partial index; alerts/events only for inserted rows)
Review: move-to-tomorrow ignored the editor's earliest time because it is stored as HH:MM, not ISO; fixed to accept both
Review: YouTube findExisting stays (a miss behaves as before); page size 25 -> 50
Brief decision c: caption.missing keeps applying to all items
Display font: Imbue (OFL, tall condensed didone), self-hosted; Inter for everything else; one font per phrase
Research generation runs as a worker job with code-written notes (no AI cost); Haiku notes are an opt-in setting with a monthly token budget, default off
Fix-it runs in the worker (always on, reads R2); originals are kept; a fix is a new media row
Screenshots and the app run on a separate clean DB (autopilot_demo); tests keep autopilot_dev, because a db test leaves rows that make the seed refuse the DB
Default daily caps become his choice (IG 6, YT 10, TikTok 7, Snapchat 1) in the Settings task
reply-ready pushes are on by default, paced by engagement.pings (default hourly digest)
Location and blocklist hits beat the promo rule, so a spam account asking where he trains still reaches him
Log out everywhere signs out sessions only; passkeys stay (revoking them from the phone would lock him out)
One solid button per card or view section
Research and analytics loaders read only official APIs; no thumbnails or media URLs from other creators are stored
